content:
maya_k: Quick heads-up — Ava L (SWE II) just confirmed she can do Thu evening UTC+1 (she's flexible by +/- 1 hour). Current panel is 16:00 UTC. I need someone to swap from the 16:00 slot to 15:00 UTC so we cover her window. @samir_patel @jordan any chance to swap?

samir_patel: I can try to move, but I already have a sync at 15:30 UTC. If I swap I'd need it to be 15:00 sharp and we'd need a 15-min buffer before the debrief.

jordan: I can take 15:00 UTC if someone else picks up my 16:30 block. Quick question on the rubric: are we still weighting system design and coding equally for SWE II, or is coding prioritized this hiring cycle?

ryan_h: Coding prioritized — hiring doc updated last week. Weighting is 55% coding, 30% system design, 15% collaboration/behaviors. Link: https://redwood.internal/hiring/swe-ii-rubric (DM if you need access).

maya_k: Thanks @ryan_h. For clarity, here's the mini-grid we'll use in the debrief (short version):
```
- Coding: 55% (correctness, speed, testable approach)
- Design: 30% (scalability, tradeoffs)
- Collaboration: 15% (communication, ownership)
- Recommend: Hire / No Hire / On-hold + Notes
```
Please keep notes tied to those bullets so the debrief is fast.

emily_reid: Also can someone remind the panel to fill the debrief within 2 hours after the interview? Ops prefers <4h but hiring manager wants quick sync. I can post a short debrief template in the thread.

people-ops-bot: Calendar invites updated: Ava L interview moved to Thu 15:00 UTC. All panelists invited. Organizer: maya_k. (If you didn't get an invite, check spam or DM people-ops.)

jordan: Got the invite, thanks. @maya_k can you drop the Zoom link here and confirm whether there's a short warm-up question we should open with?

maya_k: Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.work/j/9876543210 (passcode: redwood). Warm-up: 2-min intro + 3-min mental model question about a recent system they built. Then 40 min coding, 30 min design.

jordan: Perfect — I'll take the 15:00 slot and will lead the coding portion. Will capture notes in the debrief doc.

samir_patel: Ok I moved my 16:30 to cover Jordan's later block. All good on my side.

emily_reid: Debrief template (copy/paste):
"Candidate: Ava L
Role: SWE II
Panel: [names]
Score: Coding  /10, Design /10, Collaboration /10
Hire? [Yes/No/Maybe]
Notes: [bullet notes — tie to rubric]"

maya_k: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll ping again 10m before to confirm start. @jordan please flag anything urgent in the debrief doc after the call. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Debrief reminder will be sent 10 minutes after interview ends to panelists.
